summary: Shell plc filed a Form 6-K on July 30, 2026, announcing a Q2 2026 interim dividend of US$0.3906 per ordinary share (US$0.7812 per ADS, each ADS representing two ordinary shares) and the commencement of a share buyback programme. The dividend timetable includes ex-dividend dates in August 2026, currency election deadline August 28, and payment date September 21, 2026. Dividend reinvestment plans are available. These are routine capital return announcements by the issuer, not a special-situation event. No unusual terms, strategic actions, or structural changes are present. The buyback programme details are not provided in this excerpt. This filing is a routine dividend and buyback disclosure, so no special-situation classification applies.
